links.outcome: Recall rates and missed fractures before vs after AI fracture detection implementation
links.effect: Recalls 31/13,813 (0.22%) pre vs 27/14,842 (0.18%) post, p=0.42; fracture-related recalls 0.19% vs 0.17%, p=0.63; management change 0.0006% vs 0.0005%, p=0.551.
links.quote: Gleamer BoneView<sup>®</sup> use was linked to a non-significant decrease in missed fractures by orthopaedists working without on-site radiologists.

links.outcome: Orthopaedist fracture misdiagnosis with versus without AI assistance in deployed setting
links.effect: Missed fractures 16 pre-implementation vs 13 post; fracture-related recall rate 0.19% vs 0.17% (p=0.63), non-significant.
links.quote: Statistical analyses measured the rates of fracture misdiagnosis before and after implementation of Gleamer BoneView<sup>®</sup>.

screen.reason: Evaluates the real clinical deployment of an AI bone fracture detection tool (Gleamer BoneView) by comparing diagnostic recall/error rates before and after deployment during night shifts.
